channel.title: MYRSS Daily Digest
channel.description: Ten curated RSS-metadata summaries: two each from de Volkskrant, New York Times, Follow the Money, Reuters and The New Yorker. Reporting attributed to publishers; full articles not necessarily accessed.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Iran bevestigt luchtaanval op Koeweit
item.description: De Volkskrant reports that Iran has confirmed an air strike on Kuwait. This is based on the headline; details have not been independently verified.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Rusland grootste netto-exporteur van CO2, Qatar stoot per inwoner het meeste uit
item.description: According to de Volkskrant's headline, Russia is the largest net exporter of CO2 and Qatar has the highest per-capita emissions. The feed supplies no detailed methodology.

item.title: New York Times | Tracking China’s Intensifying War of Words Against Japan
item.description: The Times describes a concerted Chinese messaging campaign portraying Japan as an aggressor and renewed military threat, according to its analysis.

item.title: New York Times | Ecuadorean Fishermen Who Survived U.S. Boat Strike Sue Trump Administration
item.description: Survivors of a US boat strike have filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration, the Times reports. Its RSS summary describes the military campaign as secretive and says more than 240 people have died.

item.title: Follow the Money | Gelekte bank­documenten: Hongaarse partner van ING faciliteerde Russische witwas­praktijken
item.description: FTM reports that leaked documents link a major Hungarian bank to Russian money laundering and describe subsequent ties to Dutch bank ING. This summarises the RSS metadata, not the full investigation.

item.title: Follow the Money | Universiteiten stoppen projecten met Chinese collega’s die óók werken voor de krijgsmacht
item.description: FTM reports that Eindhoven and Maastricht universities stopped projects with seven Chinese universities also working for China's military. The RSS summary says other institutions remain undecided.

item.title: Reuters | Bahrain says air defences intercepted Iranian attacks
item.description: Reuters headline via Google News RSS: Bahrain says its air defences intercepted Iranian attacks. No full Reuters article text was available in the feed.

item.title: Reuters | How India became a rice powerhouse - and why it's becoming a problem
item.description: Reuters headline via Google News RSS examines India's rise as a major rice producer and associated problems. No full Reuters article text was available in the feed.

item.title: The New Yorker | The Making of Peter Bogdanovich, in His Own Words
item.description: A film essay on Peter Bogdanovich's posthumously published diaries, covering his transition from writer to director, according to the magazine's RSS summary.

item.title: The New Yorker | The Radical Intimacies of Ryûsuke Hamaguchi
item.description: A profile of Japanese director Ryûsuke Hamaguchi exploring end-of-life care and the limitations of cinema through his film All of a Sudden, according to the RSS summary.
